project_summary: Distributed World Simulator is developed through parallel domain programs under one canonical main-owned architecture and control ledger.

G.short_description: Semantic Field Fabric and its derived visual lab on top of accepted G3/G5/G6 world-generation truth.
G.purpose: Build stable semantic world fields that remain independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation, then expose them for debug/visual inspection before G8 geomorphology.
G.expected_outcome: Accepted G7 semantic-field foundation plus a graphical proof that real adapter-backed fields can be inspected without becoming canonical identity.
G.progress_note: G7.4 semantic focused work reached world regression. Shared M5 graphical acceptance then exposed an inherited final-convergence handoff deadlock: reconnect A timed out in WAIT_CONVERGENCE_PEER while B timed out in WAIT_FINAL_CONVERGENCE_PEER although both leave_result values succeeded and server joins/leaves/stale-peer checks converged. Fix2 is implemented on the G branch and must pass focused M5 before G7.4 full acceptance resumes.
G.next_stage: Verify shared M5 convergence Fix2, then G7.4 automated + manual graphical acceptance, then G7 FULL ACCEPTANCE and G8 Geomorphology

T.short_description: Construction runtime presentation and multiplayer binding over the accepted T1A.5 C5B runtime.
T.purpose: Replicate canonical Construction runtime state to clients and drive derived door/lamp/generator/console presentation without making transport or presentation authoritative gameplay truth.
T.expected_outcome: Two graphical clients and the server converge on the same runtime state while presentation remains derived, late join receives a full baseline, and no new network/authority foundation is introduced.
T.progress_note: The dedicated server + two-client focused gate passes. Full world regression is pending. PC0 also records that development advanced from T1A.5 before the transactional-effects gap identified by architecture audit was closed.
T.next_stage: Resolve T1A.5 Transactional Runtime Effects FIX1 and complete T1A.6 full regression; only then accept T1A.6 and move to T1A.7

TS.short_description: Synthetic 10k/100k Construction scale lab proving C22/C24 compiled representation without one runtime node per semantic part.
TS.purpose: Reduce representation-scale risk before T2 by testing deterministic large cube/pyramid constructs, near/mid/far representations, telemetry and later local dirty rebuild.
TS.expected_outcome: Accepted 10k and 100k visual/structural evidence showing canonical part count is decoupled from runtime node and draw-call count, without creating new global foundations.
TS.progress_note: TS0.0 is accepted. TS0.1 graphical proof is active; current manual review is checking completeness/orientation of near/mid representation before source acceptance.
TS.next_stage: TS0.1 acceptance, then TS0.2 100k Visual Scale Gate

CH.short_description: Character presentation line for skinned garment/equipment integration over stable controllable-entity gameplay identity.
CH.purpose: Improve visible player presentation and clothing/equipment composition without turning rig, mesh, garment or Skeleton identity into player canonical truth.
CH.expected_outcome: Replaceable avatar/garment presentation adapters compatible with network authority and Item equipment semantics.
CH.progress_note: CH6 presentation/crouch/shadow baseline is accepted; CH7-8 remains the declared character presentation frontier.
CH.next_stage: CH7-8 focused acceptance and later equipment/network composition

DOCTRINE.short_description: Design doctrine describing how a large simulated world produces discovery, capability, infrastructure, consequences and history.
DOCTRINE.purpose: Keep gameplay/world-building principles reusable and aligned with technical foundations without giving design documentation ownership of identity, authority, material or persistence systems.
DOCTRINE.expected_outcome: A durable design reference used to judge whether new simulation mechanics create interesting interconnected gameplay rather than isolated features.
DOCTRINE.progress_note: Doctrine remains an active design reference and must map new mechanics onto canonical queries, operations, transactions and persistent world consequences.
DOCTRINE.next_stage: Continue doctrine updates only when new gameplay/system evidence appears

NX.short_description: Realtime transport, prediction, interpolation and future authority/interest/persistence policy integration.
NX.purpose: Provide responsive server-authoritative multiplayer without allowing packet order or transport ownership to define gameplay truth.
NX.expected_outcome: Network foundations remain reusable while tuning/fix branches can be registered as active frontiers when network work becomes primary again.
NX.current_stage: Tracked; no single active NX frontier declared in PC0 generation 2
NX.progress_note: NX0-NX5 foundations are established; separate M7/FIX tuning lineage exists but is intentionally not guessed as the canonical frontier by PC0 until explicitly declared in main.
NX.next_stage: Declare the current network tuning frontier in main before the next network acceptance

MATTER.short_description: Authoritative mutable material/volume truth with durable same-body cross-region transactions and recovery.
MATTER.purpose: Provide persistent excavation/material mutation semantics for later Geo and Construction composition.
MATTER.expected_outcome: MW10 remains the accepted transaction baseline until GM/T3/T5 composition requires new declared work.
MATTER.progress_note: No active Matter frontier is declared in PC0 generation 2.
MATTER.next_stage: GM Geo-Matter integration / future composition gate

S1.short_description: Proposal-only distributed compute where workers receive projected immutable state and authority commits validated mutations.
S1.purpose: Scale simulation work without allowing workers to become authoritative world owners.
S1.expected_outcome: Reusable compute execution for future generation, AI and simulation workloads under explicit read/write contracts.
S1.progress_note: No active S1 frontier is declared in PC0 generation 2.
S1.next_stage: Register a new frontier only when a concrete workload requires it
